title: Gomboc research: AI-assisted constructions, searches and open problems
description:
Exact constructions, verification code and research records from an AI-assisted investigation of homogeneous mono-monostatic polyhedra. The C622 construction has 176 vertices, 311 edges and 137 faces, with exactly one stable and one unstable equilibrium at its uniform-volume centroid.
